Summary
T2S Solutions is seeking a Purchaser responsible for the compliant sourcing, procurement, and expediting of materials, components, and subcontracted services in support of government, aerospace, and electronics manufacturing programs. This role ensures procurement activities meet contractual, regulatory, quality, and export control requirements while supporting cost, schedule, and performance objectives. The Purchaser works closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality Assurance, Program Management, and approved suppliers to ensure timely delivery of conforming materials. This position is on-site and operates within a controlled, regulated environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support all open purchase orders within the ERP system, including vendor communications, expediting actions, and delivery schedule adherence
  • Execute the full procurement lifecycle from RFQ development through PO award, fulfillment, receipt, and closeout, including high-value and subcontract purchase orders
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with contract requirements, flow-down clauses, quality standards, and internal purchasing procedures
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance to resolve supplier nonconformances, corrective actions, and material quality issues
  • Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, and contractual conditions in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations
  • Monitor supplier performance metrics including on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost; support supplier scorecards and performance reviews
  • Develop and maintain relationships with approved and strategic suppliers to support program continuity, risk reduction, and cost control
  • Generate weekly and monthly procurement KPIs for management review, including schedule adherence, cost performance, and supplier performance
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by streamlining procurement processes, improving supplier responsiveness, and implementing best practices
  • Provide procurement support to Operations, Program Management, and Administrative teams as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred) and 10 years required prior experience in purchasing or supply chain roles within aerospace, electronics manufacturing, or government contracting environments
  • Working knowledge of ERP systems
  • Familiarity with regulated procurement environments, including quality systems and supplier compliance requirements
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage complex documentation and records
  • Ability to prioritize workload, meet aggressive schedules, and manage multiple procurements simultaneously
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills with suppliers and internal stakeholders
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with strong Excel skills
  • Demonstrated professionalism when handling proprietary, confidential, and export-controlled information

Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident, refugee, or asylee) in accordance with ITAR/EAR and other export control regulations
  • Ability to comply with government contract requirements, quality management systems, and company security policies

Compensation: 100-120k/annual (DOE)

Summary
T2S Solutions is seeking to hire a Modeling & Simulation Analyst in support of the Joint Navigation Warfare Center (JNWC). The JNWC is chartered to enable positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) and NAVWAR superiority to the Department of Defense, Combatant Commanders, Joint Force Commanders, the Coalition and the Interagency. Our mission is to provide combatant commanders and joint force commanders with subject matter expertise on planning and conducting NAVWAR by providing knowledge of friendly and enemy NAVWAR Order of Battle and PNT-related successes and threats.

Responsibilities

  • You will work with simulations that shall include technical analyses and assessments to develop recommendations, and maintain system integration labs, facilities, and analysis tools.
  • You will conduct M&S activities in support of the analyses, exercises, wargames, and experiments conducted by the Government.
  • You will provide instruction, supervision and guidance on the proper operation and use of simulation models and exercises.
  • You may support live, constructive, or virtual training.
  • Your simulation shall include technical analyses and assessments to develop recommendations, and maintain system integration labs, facilities, and analysis tools.
  • You will utilize RF modeling and simulation software to manipulate antenna and power models that visualize GPS denial in potentially affected areas.
  • You will exhibit proficiency with some or all the following: GIANT, GIANT RPM, Builder, Systems Toolkit (STK), or other modeling and simulation programs.

Qualifications

  • Current interim secret with a pathway to SCI
  • Bachelor’s degree in modeling and simulation, computer science, math, or a related field and 5+ Yrs related experience (7 Years for T4 position, 5 years for T3 position)
  • Relevant M&S experience
  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Strong attention to detail

Preferred

  • Apprentice Certified Modeling & Simulation Professional (CMSP) or equivalent
  • Ability to work independently with limited government oversight and function effectively as part of a team in a joint working environment

T2S believes that our employees are our most valuable asset, and we strive to provide them with the resources and support they need to thrive both personally and professionally. Join our team and experience the benefits of working for a company that values its employees and invests in their future!

Summary
T2S Solutions is seeking to hire an RF Engineer to support NAVWAR efforts in the Joint Navigation Warfare Center (JNWC). As a part of the Joint Navigation Warfare Center (JNWC) contract, you will be a part of our team’s efforts to empower the Department of Defense’s navigation warfare (NAVWAR) mission ensuring positioning, navigation and timing superiority. Our mission is to provide combatant commanders and joint force commanders with subject matter expertise on planning and conducting NAVWAR by providing knowledge of friendly and enemy NAVWAR Order of Battle and PNT-related successes and threats.

Responsibilities

  • Modeling and Simulation SME provides executive-level insight to NAVWAR engineering support
  • Provide research and development of multi-function small form factor payloads for completing NAVWAR-based missions
  • Develop and analyze models of novel algorithmic concepts to produce distributed electronic sensing effects for NAVWAR payloads
  • Utilize EW signal processing algorithms to enable threat detection identification for employing countermeasures; Reverse engineer existing NAVWAR signal processing solutions
  • Develop systems to support GPS system hardening to prevent NAVWAR effects on blue force systems
  • Develop RF hardware and software solutions for integrating EW, Comms, and Radar missions into a small form factor payload
  • Investigate heterogeneous sensing concepts across different platforms (i.e. manned and unmanned, high altitude ISR, ALE, etc.). Investigate sensing approaches with passive modes
  • Design and implement testing of RF and other hardware portions of software defined radio frameworks
  • Synthesize and allocate system requirements, and derive requirements to ensure the system architecture is fully defined, understood, and compliant to mission needs
  • Support development and implementation of client requirements for RF solutions including services, products, technologies and capabilities which encompass airborne mission environments
  • Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) testing on systems impact by denial/deception of PNT/GPS
  • Support technical reviews of vendor hardware and software products and deliverables, interface development and development of software algorithms and models for simulation
  • Research of the state-of-the-art signal processing algorithms
  • Work with customers (both internal and external to JNWC) to help integrate solutions into a wide variety of applications and use cases?
  • Debug, test, and validate our capabilities using both unit tests as well as scenarios reported by the JNWC or JNWC Customers? ?

Qualifications

  • Current DoD issued Security Clearance
  • BA/BS in engineering or related technical field and 3-10 years of relevant experience
  • Must have prior leadership or management experience in higher-level roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer License (PE) for senior level
  • MS Degree

Senior Cloud Systems Administrator - DCGS-A
Security Clearance: Secret - TS/SCI
Location: APG, MD

Summary
T2S Solutions is currently hiring a Senior Cloud Systems Administrator to support our government customer at Aberdeen Proving Ground. This key role will be responsible for Security & Compliance, Cloud Management, Scripting & Automation, and Identity Access Management IAM.

Cloud & Subscription Management

  • Azure Government Administration: Administer and sustain secure, multi-subscription environments strictly within Azure Government, including dedicated experience navigating cArmy and the Enterprise Cloud Management Agency (ECMA) frameworks
  • Modern Deployment & Connectivity: Deploy and manage virtual machines, storage, networking components, and identity services. Must possess a strong understanding of Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) mechanics and the secure protocols required to connect and execute administrative actions using elevated/privileged accounts
  • Application Hosting: Deploy and maintain application workloads (including Linux-based workloads) utilizing modern hosting architectures such as Containers and Azure App Services (utilizing OneDeploy with .zip or .jar packages)

Security, Compliance, & Troubleshooting (Core Focus)

  • Vulnerability & Compliance Management: Actively monitor, document, and accurately report Information Assurance Vulnerability Management (IAVM) compliance. Execute and maintain STIG checklists to ensure all infrastructure meets rigorous hardening standards
  • Operational Directives: Rapidly analyze, coordinate, and execute technical actions in response to Cyber Tasking Orders (CTOs)
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex system outages. Must be proficient in analyzing network, firewall, and proxy traffic using packet capture (PCAP) tools (e.g., Wireshark) to isolate connectivity issues
  • Above-Baseline Software Updates: Perform and validate above-baseline software updates and configurations. Routine, baseline system maintenance and patching are automated via a Managed Service Provider (MSP), allowing this role to focus on high-impact deployment tasks

Scripting & Automation

  • Command Line Proficiency: Utilize Azure CLI and PowerShell to query resources, automate repetitive administrative tasks, and streamline cloud operations (Note: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is not utilized for standard deployments)

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

  • Deep RBAC & Entra ID Expertise: Maintain and troubleshoot identity, access, and directory services utilizing Microsoft Entra ID
  • Complex Group Authorization: Demonstrate a deep conceptual understanding of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), security groups, and nested permission structures. Candidates must be able to navigate and troubleshoot complex environments where roles are dynamically mapped to security groups through custom, obfuscated web application authorization systems

Operations & Professional

  • Service Desk Integration: Manage, document, and resolve technical issues systematically through an enterprise ticketing system/service desk
  • Communication & Collaboration: Deliver clear, concise, and professional technical communications within the team and directly to end-users/customers

Requirements & Certifications

  • Clearance: Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance
  • Core Certifications: Must possess Security+ (or equivalent IAT Level II certification) AND a relevant cloud environment certification (e.g., AZ-104 Azure Administrator, SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator, or equivalent) or 5 years relevant experience

Summary

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, the ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing to a wide range of staff and audiences, and a deep understanding of the DOTML PF framework. The Operations Officer will work closely with internal and external stakeholders, synchronize major Army Futures Command events, plan actions and milestone glidepaths, and ensure seamless coordination of staff actions across all levels.

  • Effective Communication: Present information and reports orally and in writing to various staff and audiences, maintaining clarity and professionalism.
  • DOTML PF Expertise: Possess a strong understanding of the DOTML PF framework to guide decision-making and planning processes.
  • Staff Coordination: Coordinate staff actions both internally and externally, fostering collaboration and information sharing.
  • Event Synchronization: Synchronize major Army Futures Command events to align with NCFT goals and objectives.
  • Planning and Milestones: Develop action plans and milestone glidepaths to achieve NCFT objectives within specified timelines.
  • Senior Leader Engagement: Work closely with Army Senior Leaders to provide updates and support their needs.

  • Operational View Charts: Understand and utilize operational view charts to enhance decision-making.
  • Battle Rhythm Meetings: Participate in and contribute to internal meetings to ensure alignment with organizational goals.

  • Milestone Decision Points: Maintain and track reporting of milestone decision points to monitor progress and identify potential issues.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Leadership and team collaboration skills
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams
  • Experience preparing reports, briefings, meeting minutes, correspondence, and program documentation
  • Experience tracking schedules, deliverables, action items, and project status

Summary
T2S Solutions is currently hiring a Coalition Interoperability Subject Matter Expert (SME) at
Aberdeen Proving Ground. The Army Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) Coalition
Interoperability Subject Matter Expert (SME) will serve as the primary technical, operational, and
policy advisor to the Command and Control Future Capability Directorate (C2 FCD) for ensuring NGC2
capabilities are fully interoperable with U.S. Allies and Mission Partners across the human,
procedural, and technical domains.

The SME will focus on enabling seamless integration and interoperability of NGC2 technologies at
echelon in coalition environments. This includes system-of-systems integration, data architecture
and standards alignment, technology refresh, architecture assessments, automation opportunities,
and technical insertion planning. The position requires deep knowledge of both NGC2 modernization
efforts and established multinational interoperability frameworks (including ABCANZ, FMN, STANAGs,
and MIP) to reduce integration friction and enable effective combined operations with allies. The
SME maintains a detailed understanding of NATO, coalition, U.S., and partner interoperability
policies, standards, architectures, and programs; assesses how they enable, constrain, or influence
coalition operations and capability development; identifies interoperability risks and
opportunities; advises capability sponsors and operational users; and supports the integration of
interoperable solutions to improve multinational readiness, agility, and operational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed system-of-systems integration analysis across hardware, software, networks,
  • applications, interfaces, data services, infrastructure, ontologies, schemas, and supporting
  • technologies
  • Analyze and interpret NATO, coalition, U.S., and partner interoperability policies, standards,
  • and architectures, advising stakeholders on their operational relevance and impact
  • Assess current and emerging NGC2 architectures, data standards, and technical solutions for
  • compatibility with Allied C2 systems, with specific focus on alignment with standards and related coalition frameworks.
  • Identify interoperability opportunities, gaps, risks, and dependencies and provide actionable
  • recommendations
  • Conduct technology refresh audits and develop technology refresh assessments and
  • roadmaps
  • Evaluate technical and operational workflows to identify opportunities for automation, orchestration, process improvement, and reduction of manual effort
  • Design, assess, or recommend automation, integration, and data-sharing solutions
  • Conduct technology scouting and evaluate emerging commercial, Government, and developmental technologies
  • Develop technology insertion recommendations that clearly identify how and when new capabilities should be introduced into existing and future NGC2 environments
  • Expertise or the function of informing/developing requirements for MPE and coalition capabilities and networks
  • Experience leveraging Super Intelligence and agentic tools
  • Conduct technical trade studies and analyses of alternatives
  • Evaluate current-state, transition-state, and objective architectures with emphasis on data fabrics, semantic interoperability, ontologies, schemas, and cross-domain information exchange
  • Assess advanced AI/ML and data analytics capabilities for applicability to automation, systems integration, decision support, and coalition interoperability
  • Assess the interoperability implications of proposed technical solutions, system architectures,
  • and information exchange requirements
  • Support the development of coalition interoperability roadmaps and implementation
  • plans

  • efforts) to confirm operational effectiveness

  • consolidate, modernize, or retire technologies, systems, and processes
  • Provide subject matter expertise to capability development, experimentation, acquisition, and operational planning activities.
  • Actively participate in and support key coalition interoperability forums
  • Represent the organization at multinational interoperability forums, working groups,

  • Build and maintain relationships with allies, partners, government organizations, industry, and capability sponsors
  • Facilitate collaboration between operational users, technical experts, and programme teams
  • Monitor emerging interoperability initiatives, standards, and technologies, identifying opportunities to improve coalition integration
  • Capture and disseminate lessons identified and best practice from exercises, operations, and
  • experimentation activities
  • Act as a trusted advisor on multinational command and control, data exchange, information
  • sharing, and coalition integration challenges.
  • Develop and deliver high-quality written products (information papers, technical assessments,
  • roadmaps, EXSUMs, briefings, and trip reports) and participate in working groups, exercises, and senior leader engagements as required.
  • Continually research and provide recommendations for emerging technology insertions (including artificial and super intelligence enablers)

  • Experience supporting or observing military exercises involving Joint and/or multinational
  • forces
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams,

Summary
T2S Solutions is seeking to hire a Maintenance Engineering Expert in APG, MD. This role provides maintenance engineering, reliability, maintainability, logistics, and lifecycle-sustainment support for Department of War (DoW) and Army systems and equipment. The contractor supports government-led efforts to develop, assess, implement, and improve maintenance concepts that optimize readiness, availability, safety, affordability, and long-term sustainment.

The successful candidate will apply expertise in maintenance concept development, reliability and maintainability (RAM), condition-based maintenance (CBM+), performance-based logistics (PBL), provisioning, sparing, technical manuals, system safety, human performance, and fielded-system problem resolution. The role requires the ability to translate operational and technical requirements into practical sustainment strategies, maintenance plans, analyses, and decision-ready products.

Responsibilities

  • Maintenance Concept Development and Analysis
  • Support development, refinement, validation, and implementation of maintenance concepts for new, modified, and fielded systems.
  • Conduct requirements determination and maintenance engineering analyses to identify maintenance levels, tasks, resources, personnel, facilities, support equipment, and training requirements.
  • Develop and assess maintenance concepts using Level of Repair Analysis (LORA), COMPASS, SESAME, and other government-directed methodologies and analytical tools.
  • Conduct core logistics analyses, sparing analyses, and overall repair-parts concepts to support operational availability, readiness, affordability, and lifecycle sustainment.
  • Support performance-based logistics planning, including development of supportability objectives, performance measures, sustainment strategies, and risk assessments.
  • Support condition-based maintenance plus (CBM+) planning and implementation activities, including condition-monitoring requirements, data-use considerations, diagnostic/prognostic approaches, and maintenance-decision support.
  • Analyze maintenance processes and recommend improvements to reduce downtime, improve repair-cycle time, increase readiness, and reduce total ownership cost.

Reliability, Maintainability, and Quality Engineering

  • Conduct long-term system reliability and maintainability analyses, including Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Mean Time To Repair (MTTR), availability, failure trends, repair-cycle time, and supportability metrics.
  • Support RAM requirements determination, allocation, analysis, verification, and reporting throughout the system lifecycle.
  • Conduct or support reliability simulation, modeling, testing, and program-management activities.
  • Perform system maintainability assessments addressing design accessibility, diagnostics, fault isolation, repair procedures, required skill levels, tooling, support equipment, and safety considerations.
  • Support reliability and quality engineering and assurance activities, including review and analysis of Product Quality Deficiency Reports (PQDRs), recurring failures, defect trends, corrective actions, and verification of improvement efforts.
  • Identify reliability, maintainability, and quality risks; assess their operational and sustainment impacts; and develop recommended mitigation options.
  • Support Engineering Change Proposal-related technical analysis when changes may affect maintenance, supportability, safety, reliability, or lifecycle costs.
  • Technical Publications, Provisioning, and Supportability Products
  • Support development, review, validation, and maintenance of Technical Manuals (TMs), Repair Parts and Special Tools Lists (RPSTLs), Maintenance Allocation Charts (MACs), and related sustainment documentation.
  • Support maintenance demonstrations and validation activities to confirm maintenance-task feasibility, technical-publication accuracy, support-equipment needs, tooling requirements, personnel skill requirements, and repair-time estimates.
  • Support provisioning management, including identification and validation of repair parts, special tools, test equipment, consumables, and initial-spares requirements.
  • Review technical data and logistics products for completeness, accuracy, configuration alignment, usability, and consistency with approved maintenance concepts.
  • Support materiel-release activities by providing maintenance, supportability, reliability, technical-publication, and provisioning input, as directed.
  • Identify technical-publication, provisioning, or supportability gaps that could delay fielding, increase maintenance burden, or adversely affect readiness.

Human Performance, Safety, and Fielded-System Support

  • Conduct ergonomic and human-performance analyses to improve maintainability, user safety, workload, accessibility, physical demands, and effectiveness of maintenance activities.
  • Support system-safety analyses as they relate to maintenance procedures, maintenance hazards, human factors, equipment design, and technical-publication content.
  • Analyze Equipment Improvement Recommendations (EIRs), PQDRs, user feedback, maintenance data, and other fielded-system information to identify root causes and support problem resolution.
  • Support resolution of fielded-system maintenance, reliability, quality, and sustainment issues through technical analysis, stakeholder coordination, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Assess demilitarization (DEMIL) challenges and support planning for maintenance-related disposal, disposition, safety, environmental, and lifecycle considerations, as applicable.
  • Develop and deliver maintenance concept engineering training, workshops, technical briefings, and knowledge-transfer materials for authorized government and contractor stakeholders.

Program and Project Support

  • Support integrated product teams and cross-functional coordination among engineering, logistics, program management, technical publications, quality, safety, contracting, and operational stakeholders.
  • Develop decision-ready maintenance concept documents, analyses, briefings, reports, action trackers, risk registers, schedules, and recommendations.
  • Support planning and execution of maintenance-engineering reviews, sustainment assessments, technical-data reviews, maintenance demonstrations, and readiness-related meetings.
  • Track maintenance-concept implementation actions, dependencies, risks, and milestones throughout development, fielding, sustainment, and modernization phases.
  • Support analysis of lifecycle sustainment costs and recommend strategies to improve readiness, reliability, maintainability, and affordability.

Required Qualifications

Relevant additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree where permitted by contract requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience developing or assessing maintenance concepts, maintenance plans, sustainment strategies, or product-support analyses.
  • Working knowledge of RAM principles, reliability metrics, maintainability analysis, maintenance-task analysis, provisioning, and sparing concepts.
  • Experience supporting technical manuals, RPSTLs, MACs, maintenance demonstrations, technical-data reviews, or related logistics-support products.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical, operational, reliability, maintenance, logistics, safety, and cost data and communicate conclusions clearly.
  • Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, plans, briefings, and decision-support materials.
  • Strong written communication, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-coordination skills.

  • Experience supporting Army, DoW, program executive office, lifecycle management command, depot, sustainment command, or major defense acquisition programs.
